name: netflix_strangerthings5_trailer

source.title: Stranger Things 5 | Official Trailer | Netflix
source.note: source fields fixed by hand (title contains |)

cuts.method: cuts2.py adaptive detector (ratio 3.0, abs 0.25); black flashes folded by stats2.py; spot-checked by eye on verify pairs + sheet

beatsync: onsets/s 0.59 cuts on onset (+-0.1s) 23 % vs chance 11 %
empty_frame: mostly-empty 23% (on dark 23%, on light 0%), median empty share 47%
manual_corrections: Trimmed to 161.2 s (end screen). Cuts checked by eye on verify pairs + cand strips: added 12 soft/fade cuts (6.1,24.0,31.6,58.6,88.1,92.0,115.5,127.3,143.8,156.1,157.7,158.6), no false positives removed. Beatsync after correction unchanged: 23 % vs 11 % chance.

manual.trim_reason: 161.2-174.4 s is the YouTube end screen (N + SUBSCRIBE), not part of the trailer
manual.letterbox: 2.00:1 inside 16:9 (active picture ~854x426 of 854x480, bars ~27 px = 5.6% H top and bottom); end cards also letterboxed

corner_bug.0-4.9 s: top-left red vertical rule + 'STRANGER THINGS: / SEASON 5' white sans 2 lines, cap ~1.9% H at x5-21%, y10-12%; top-right grey N monogram ~7.5% H
corner_bug.5-145 s: 'NETFLIX' wordmark top-right, ~4% H (ink 4.8%), x85-95%, y10-15% (just inside the picture under the letterbox bar), semi-transparent light grey; hidden on the red text cards

n_sting.look: red N built from light ribbons over the show's Upside-Down vine texture, red light bars left/right, N ~57% H, fades to a plain N on black at 15.5 then black

n_sting.where: last shot after a glitch transition
n_sting.look: N ribbon-light logo ~42% H on dark with red side bars, audio tail ~-29 to -33 dBFS with a small bump at 159.25 s (probably the ta-dum, guess)

text_cards.assemble_note: letters assemble ~75.75-78.0 s (timed on a 4 fps strip, +-0.25 s)

light-grey heavy geometric sans caps (Netflix Sans Bold-like), soft white glow, on black

timing_note: All times come from cut detection, cand.py/ffmpeg -ss frames or audio; strip-timed values are flagged. Contact-sheet tile k shows the frame at ~k+0.96 s.
